payload.author: claude
payload.body: Fixed in main (local) via 60a97bc. NOTE on root cause: the literal premise (verify:generated regenerating stale docs) was NOT reproducible — on clean main 'pnpm verify:generated' exits 0 with zero tracked changes, and no generator/lifecycle hook writes those 7 docs (grep-confirmed). The drift the worktree agents saw was a transient fresh-install/worktree artifact, not generated output. The real, fixable gap matching this bug's title: check-generated-artifacts.ts only diff-checked 9 hardcoded paths, so any generator output outside that list would evade CI. Fix broadens the gate to flag ANY generator-induced tracked-file drift (before/after snapshot of the whole tracked tree). Passes clean on main.
